items.title: Radhika Sarathkumar-starrer ‘Delivery Boy’ to hit screens on October 23
items.sum: Director Nani's emotional action entertainer Delivery Boy will release worldwide in theatres on October 23. The film stars Leo Sivakumar, Brigida, and Radhika Sarathkumar in the lead roles, alongside Dushyanth, Kaali Venkat, and Bose Venkat. Director Nani stated that the plot follows a lower middle class delivery boy trying to save his mother. The 42-day shoot was completed across Chennai and Coimbatore before wrapping up in December last year.

items.title: Indian 3 Release Date Buzz; Kamal Haasan-Shankar Film Gets New Update As Senapathy Returns
items.sum: Lyca Productions released a fresh update for Indian 3 on Thursday, October 8, bringing the Kamal Haasan and Shankar film back into focus. The studio shared new posters featuring the vigilante character Senapathy with the tagline Senapathy is back with zero tolerance and the hashtag War Mode. The announcement tagged key cast and crew members including Siddharth, Kajal Aggarwal, SJ Suryah, and music composer Anirudh Ravichander. Although the makers did not reveal any theatrical release schedule, the update has sparked unconfirmed social media speculation about a possible Pongal 2027 release.

items.title: Scene Movie First Song ‘Aathi Iva Yarraa’ Released – Suriya and Jithu Madhavan’s Action Comedy Hits Theatres November 6
items.sum: Suriya and director Jithu Madhavan's upcoming action comedy Scene is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on November 6, 2026. The makers have launched the film's first single titled Aathi Iva Yarraa, composed by Sushin Shyam with lyrics, vocals, and choreography by Raj Priyan. Suriya plays a police officer named Imbaraj IPS in the film, which features a cast including Naslen, Nazriya Nazim, Anandaraj, and Lal. Netflix has secured the OTT streaming rights for the project, though its digital premiere date remains unannounced.
